LavaCore was created by Noodlesdoodlescuddles.

🔥 LAVA CORE FPS — Roblox Performance Optimizer

LAVA CORE focuses on reducing unnecessary rendering workload through:

• 📊 Live FPS counter
• ⚙️ Batched performance optimization to reduce stutter
• 🎨 Texture-distance LOD — hides distant textures and adjusts MeshPart RenderFidelity
• ✨ VFX culling — particles, trails, beams, smoke, fire, sparkles & highlights
• 💥 Special-effect culling — auras, explosions, magic, rifts, quests & reward VFX
• 💡 Dynamic-light & global-shadow optimization
• 🌫️ Atmosphere, clouds & post-processing reduction
• 🌊 Terrain & water optimization
• 🖥️ GUI/camera cosmetic VFX optimization
• 🔄 Continuous monitoring for newly spawned effects
• 🧩 Batched processing to avoid constantly scanning everything at once
• 📈 FPS monitoring while the optimizer is running

LAVA CORE doesn't magically create performance — it reduces the amount of visual work Roblox has to render.
